title: Minimalist header — contrast on the actual wallpaper

steps.path: Header over Meadow Mist and Midnight
steps.headline: Each control carries enough of its theme's own surface to separate its contents from the wallpaper.
steps.changed: Instead of choosing a stronger glow by eye, the prototype places a translucent, local theme-panel backing inside header controls and the session switcher. Status dots keep their meaning: colored dots have a matching soft bloom, while the neutral inactive dots adapt toward the theme's foreground. There is no full-width veil or white ring.
steps.notice: This is a visual prototype, not a shipped algorithm. On Meadow Mist, three sampled control interiors improved from about 3.1–3.5:1 against the wallpaper to about 7.9–8.2:1 for the theme's secondary text color. If the feel is right, the next step is a reusable treatment with image-region checks and guarded fallback for other bare-background controls; the composer and chips stay unchanged.
